description: This file defines a base class for stream handling in a WebSocket context, including custom exceptions and methods for reading and writing data over a network connection.

classes.name: ConnectionTerminatedException
classes.description: Exception raised when a connection is unexpectedly terminated.

classes.name: InvalidFrameException
classes.description: Exception raised for invalid frames that cannot be parsed.

classes.name: BadOperationException
classes.description: Exception for invalid send/receive operations on terminated connections.

classes.name: UnsupportedFrameException
classes.description: Exception for unsupported frame flags or opcodes.

classes.name: InvalidUTF8Exception
classes.description: Exception for invalid UTF-8 strings in text frames.

classes.name: StreamBase
classes.description: Base class for stream handling, providing methods for reading and writing bytes over a network connection.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes StreamBase with a request object.

methods.name: _read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the connection, raising exceptions on failure.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the connection, handling exceptions.

methods.name: receive_bytes
methods.description: Receives multiple bytes, retrying as needed.

methods.name: _read_until
methods.description: Reads bytes until a delimiter character is encountered.
